sections.title: of ticket sales, never more than ₹10,000 a month.
sections.trial: Free for 30 days from your first event, 90 for founding hosts. Payment gateway fees are separate.

items.question: Can students pay a different price from guests?
items.answer: Set up separate events or ask applicants who they are; the price they see is the price they pay, by UPI or card.

items.question: Can our volunteers run the door?
items.answer: Yes. Give each volunteer door access for one event, on their own phone. It ends with the event.

items.question: What happens when the committee changes?
items.answer: Your page, followers, events and records stay. Add next year’s team and take the old team’s access away.

items.question: Our events are mostly free. Is that OK?
items.answer: Yes. Free events stay free. You pay 5% only on tickets sold, and never more than ₹10,000 a month.

items.question: Do students need an app?
items.answer: No. They book, pay and check in on your page in their phone’s browser.

items.question: Can alumni chapters in different cities use it?
items.answer: Yes. Each meetup is its own event on your page. Ask us for a walkthrough and we’ll help you set up the chapters.
